name: Silver carp (invasive)
desc: A filter feeder that eats mostly phytoplankton and also zooplankton. Competes with paddlefish, gizzard shad and young fish. The NPS works to keep invasive carp downstream.
about: The silver carp or silverfin is a species of freshwater cyprinid fish, a variety of Asian carp native to China and eastern Siberia, from the Amur River drainage in the north to the Xi Jiang River…
